name: chrome-image-to-text
description: LocalOCR: Screen to Text – Chrome extension (Manifest V3), 100% offline. Build: src/ -> deploy/.

scripts.pack: npm run build && cd deploy && rm -f ../localocr-screen-to-text.zip && zip -r ../localocr-screen-to-text.zip . -x '*.md'
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:autotest && node tests/run2.cjs tests/deploy-autotest
